item.tib: gshen rab rnam par rgyal ba'i gter bum 'dzugs thabs ngo mtshar rmad byung snang ba'i dga' ston
item.coloph: de srid snang ba'i dga' ston spel ba 'di/ skyabs mchog sman ri ba yi phyag len gang / rim gyis brgyud nas mkhas mang zhal gyi rgyun/ yid kyi rdzing bur 'khyil pa 'di/ 'gro la sman pa'i rnam dkar bsam pa dang / mkhan chen nyi ma'i mtshan can bka' gnang zhing / rus kyi khu bor rtogs pa'i thos phra ba/ drung mu nyi wer lhag bsam dag pas bsgrigs/ dge des bstan pa'i dar chen 'dzugs par shog/
